
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/MeteorSeed/p/19859617" title="发布于 2026-04-14 09:15">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">本地大模型部署全攻略：从 0 到 1 玩转 Ollama</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                    <div id="cnblogs_post_description" style="display: none">
        <img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202604/270073-20260413142702256-396753754.png" alt="本地大模型部署全攻略：从 0 到 1 玩转 Ollama" class="desc_img">
        在 AI 大模型爆发的今天，我们不再需要依赖昂贵的云服务，也能在自己的电脑上部署并运行强大的大语言模型。Ollama 就是这样一款工具，它让本地部署和使用大模型变得前所未有的简单。
    </div>
<div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span>　　在 AI 大模型爆发的今天，我们不再需要依赖昂贵的云服务，也能在自己的电脑上部署并运行强大的大语言模型。Ollama 就是这样一款工具，它让本地部署和使用大模型变得前所未有的简单。</span></p>
<h1><span><span>核心功能特性</span></span></h1>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- 开源免费</strong>：<span>Ollama 核心框架为开源免费，个人与企业日常本地部署、二次开发及商业集成均无费用，且官方支持商用。</span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- 跨平台</strong>：对&nbsp;<span>Windows、macOS、Linux 等<span>主流桌面与服务器系统均原生支持。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- 配置简单且功能强大</strong>：<span>Ollama 会自动检测你的硬件（GPU、CPU），优先放到显存，显存不够的部分，自动放到内存，推理时，GPU 层和 CPU 层接力计算，用户完全无感知，无需复杂配置，就能最大化利用本地算力。</span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- 流式输出</strong><span>：Ollama 支持逐字实时返回模型生成内容，无需等待完整响应生成完成，实现类似 ChatGPT 的“边想边说”效果。</span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- 深度思考</strong>：支持模型多步推理、逻辑拆解、复杂问题分步思考，模拟人类<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">“<span>先想后答<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">”<span>的思维过程，提升复杂任务的回答准确性。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- 结构化输出</strong>：强制模型生成符合指定格式的结构化数据，如 JSON、XML、CSV 等，确保输出可直接被程序解析，无需额外清洗。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- 多模态视觉理解</strong>：支持图像输入与理解，模型可识别图片内容、OCR 文字、图表、截图等，实现图文混合交互。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- 向量化</strong>：将文本等内容转换为向量，用于语义相似度计算、检索增强生成（RAG）等场景。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- 工具调用</strong>：模型可自动识别并调用外部工具 / 函数，如计算器、API 接口、本地脚本、数据库查询等，扩展模型能力边界。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- 联网搜索</strong>：模型可实时联网获取最新信息，补充模型静态知识，回答时效性强、动态变化的问题。</span></span></p>
<h1><span><span>安装部署</span></span></h1>
<p><span>　　Ollama 支持 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 三大主流系统，安装过程非常直观。（仅介绍常用的&nbsp;<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">Windows 安装，其他方式请参考官网文档）</span></span></p>
<h2><span><span>Windows 上安装 Ollama</span></span></h2>
<p><strong>Step 01 官网下载安装程序</strong></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;},&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">&nbsp; &nbsp; - https://ollama.com/download/windows</span></p>
<p><strong>Step 02 运行程序并修改配置</strong></p>
<p><span><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202604/270073-20260413140851012-643189637.png" alt="1" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></span></p>
<p><span>　　Ollama 运行本地模型时，免费且没有限制，无需登录。但是&nbsp;<span>Ollama 云端模型和联网搜索功能，必须登录 Ollama 账号才能使用。</span></span></p>
<p><span>　　Ollama 的定价参考：<span>https://ollama.com/pricing</span></span></p>
<p><span><span><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202604/270073-20260413140925745-2060913795.png" alt="3" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></span></span></p>
<p><strong>Step 03 下载模型并验证</strong></p>
<div><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202604/270073-20260413141017578-634731513.png" alt="5" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></div>
<h1>模型选择</h1>
<p>　　Ollama 官方库中拥有大量模型，选择合适的模型是关键。</p>
<p><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202604/270073-20260413141140130-847902742.png" alt="4" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></p>
<h2>模型命名&nbsp; &nbsp;</h2>
<p>　　首先，要了解大模型的命名规则为：</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">&lt;品牌+版本&gt;:&lt;参数&gt;&lt;方向&gt;&lt;量化&gt;&lt;特殊标签&gt;
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　命名不是强制要求，部分会忽略，只显示用户最关心的参数，所以不同模型会让人感觉命名规则不标准。&nbsp; &nbsp;比如：</p>
<p>　　- qwen3.5:9b：通义千问 3.5 系列<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">&nbsp;:&nbsp;90 亿（9 Billion）参数规模</span></p>
<p><span><span>　　- qwen3.5:397b-cloud：通义千问 3.5 系列<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">&nbsp;: 3<span>970 亿（397 Billion）参数规模 - 云端运行模型</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　-&nbsp;<span><span>qwen3-coder:30b：通义千问 3 编码系列 : 300 亿<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">（30 Billion）参数规模<span><br></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>　　-&nbsp;<span><span>qwen3-vl:8b：通义千问 3 视觉 - 语言多模态系列<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">&nbsp;:&nbsp;<span>80 亿参数（8 Billion）<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">参数规模</span></span></span></span></span></span></span></p>

<h2><span><span>按使用场景选择</span></span></h2>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- 通用对话及写作</strong>：qwen3.5:9b 等</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- 代码开发</strong>：qwen3-coder:30b,&nbsp;<span>deepseek-coder-v2:16b 等</span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- 图文理解</strong>：<span>qwen3-vl:8b 等</span></span></span></p>
<h2><span><span>使用方式选择</span></span></h2>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- 本地模型</strong>：免费，没有限制，运行占用本地现显存/内存</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- 云端模型</strong>：需要登录 Ollama 账号，有额度和限制，占用 Ollama 官方服务器资源，不占用本地资源</span></span></p>

<span><br></span>
<h1><span><span>自定义模型</span></span></h1>
<p><span>　　Ollama 允许通过创建 Modelfile，打造一个拥有独特个性和能力的专属模型。</span></p>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">　　Modelfile&nbsp;<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">文件写法参考：<span>https://github.com/ollama/ollama/blob/main/docs/modelfile.mdx</span></span></span></span></p>
<h2><span><span>创建 Modelfile</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　新建一个名为&nbsp;<span>devQwen 的<span>&nbsp;Modelfile 的文本文件，写入以下内容：</span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202604/270073-20260413141447821-1388167710.png" alt="9" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></span></span></p>
<h2><span><span>创建新模型</span></span></h2>
<p><span><span><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202604/270073-20260413141529338-1170813108.png" alt="8" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></span></span></p>
<p>&nbsp;</p>
<h2><span><span>运行新模型</span></span></h2>
<p><span><span><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202604/270073-20260413141551418-824579078.png" alt="11" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></span></span></p>
<h1><span><span>通过 Ollama 启动 OpenClaw<span><br></span></span></span></h1>
<p><span>　　安装前，请先安装 Node.js 与 Git，然后运行：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">ollama launch openclaw
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　或</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">ollama launch openclaw --model kimi-k2.5:cloud</pre>
</div>
<p><span>　　Ollama 将自动完成以下操作：</span></p>
<p><span>　　<strong>-&nbsp;</strong><span><strong>安装</strong>&nbsp;—— 若未安装 OpenClaw，Ollama 会提示通过 npm 进行安装</span></span></p>
<p><span><span><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202604/270073-20260413141806101-1504049950.png" alt="16" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></span></span></p>
<p><span>　　<strong>-&nbsp;</strong><span><strong>安全</strong>&nbsp;—— 首次启动时，安全须知会说明工具访问存在的相关风险</span></span></p>
<p><span><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202604/270073-20260413141839971-2112478679.png" alt="18" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></span></p>
<p><span>　　<strong>-&nbsp;</strong><span><strong>模型</strong>&nbsp;—— 从选择器中挑选本地或云端模型</span></span></p>
<p><span><span><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202604/270073-20260413141920705-1022447749.png" alt="17" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></span></span></p>
<p data-pm-slice="2 2 []"><span>　　<strong>-&nbsp;</strong><span><strong>初始化引导</strong>&nbsp;—— Ollama 配置服务提供商、安装网关守护进程、将所选模型设为默认主模型，并安装网页搜索与内容抓取插件（<span>网页搜索与内容抓取会自动启用）</span></span></span></p>
<p><span>　　<strong>-&nbsp;</strong><span><strong>网关</strong>&nbsp;—— 在后台启动程序并打开 OpenClaw 终端交互界面</span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202604/270073-20260413141948648-588918590.png" alt="19" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">&nbsp; &nbsp; 　　运行后，可访问 OpenClaw：</span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202604/270073-20260413142002209-1411685646.png" alt="21" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></span></span></p>
<h2><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>推荐模型</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　- kimi-k2.5:cloud&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">　　-&nbsp;<span>minimax-m2.7:cloud&nbsp;</span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">　　-&nbsp;<span>glm-5:cloud&nbsp;</span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">　　-&nbsp;<span>glm-4.7-flash&nbsp;</span></span></p>
<h2><span><span>推荐上下文长度</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　建议至少采用 64k 的上下文长度。</span></p>
<h2><span><span>停止运行&nbsp;<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;text-indent: 0px;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>OpenClaw</span></span></span></span></h2>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">openclaw gateway stop
</pre>
</div>
<h1>通过 Ollama 启动 Claude Code</h1>
<p><span>　　开源模型可通过 Ollama 兼容 Anthropic 的接口接入 Claude Code，支持 qwen3.5、glm-5:cloud、kimi-k2.5:cloud 等模型。</span></p>
<h2><span><span>Windows 安装 Claude Code</span></span></h2>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">irm https://claude.ai/install.ps1 | iex
</pre>
</div>
<h2>启动 Claude Code</h2>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">ollama launch claude
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　或</p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">ollama launch claude --model kimi-k2.5:cloud</pre>
</div>
<h2><span><span>推荐模型</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　- kimi-k2.5:cloud</span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">　　-&nbsp;<span>glm-5:cloud</span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">　　-&nbsp;<span>minimax-m2.7:cloud</span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">　　-&nbsp;<span>qwen3.5:cloud</span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">　　-&nbsp;<span>glm-4.7-flash</span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">　　-&nbsp;<span>qwen3.5</span></span></p>
<h2><span><span>推荐上下文长度</span></span></h2>
<p><span><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">　　建议至少采用 64k 的上下文长度。</span></span></p>
<h1><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;section&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;style&quot;:&quot;text-indent: 0px;text-align: left;&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>接口</span></span></h1>
<p><span>　　可通过接口调用将 Ollama 集成至你的应用中，其<span>安默认访问地址为：</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　- 本地地址：<span>http://localhost:11434/api</span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　- 云端地址<span>：<span>https://ollama.com/api</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span>　　在本地访问无需身份验证，云端访问则需要进行身份验证。Ollama 支持<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">本地登录和 API Key&nbsp;<span>两种身份验证方式。</span></span></span></p>
<h2><span><span>流式传输</span></span></h2>
<p><span><span>　　部分 API 接口默认以流式形式返回响应结果，采用换行分隔的 JSON 格式（application/x-ndjson 内容类型）进行传输，其形如：</span></span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">{"model":"gemma3","created_at":"2025-10-26T17:15:24.097767Z","response":"That","done":false}
{"model":"gemma3","created_at":"2025-10-26T17:15:24.109172Z","response":"'","done":false}
{"model":"gemma3","created_at":"2025-10-26T17:15:24.121485Z","response":"s","done":false}
{"model":"gemma3","created_at":"2025-10-26T17:15:24.132802Z","response":" a","done":false}
{"model":"gemma3","created_at":"2025-10-26T17:15:24.143931Z","response":" fantastic","done":false}
{"model":"gemma3","created_at":"2025-10-26T17:15:24.155176Z","response":" question","done":false}
{"model":"gemma3","created_at":"2025-10-26T17:15:24.166576Z","response":"!","done":true, "done_reason": "stop"}
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　可通过在请求体中传入{"stream": false}来关闭流式传输，响应将以application/json 内容类型返回。</p>
<h2><span><span>返回值</span></span></h2>
<p><span>　　返回值形如：</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_Highlighter">
<pre class="brush:csharp;gutter:true;">{
  "model": "gemma3",
  "created_at": "2025-10-17T23:14:07.414671Z",
  "response": "Hello! How can I help you today?",
  "done": true,
  "done_reason": "stop", 
  "total_duration": 174560334, 
  "load_duration": 101397084,
  "prompt_eval_count": 11,
  "prompt_eval_duration": 13074791,
  "eval_count": 18,
  "eval_duration": 52479709
}
</pre>
</div>
<p>　　常见字段包括：</p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- model</strong>: 模型名</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- created_at</strong>: 响应创建时间戳</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- response</strong>: 模型生成的文本回复</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- thinking</strong>：模型生成的思考输出</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- done</strong>: 生成流程是否完成</span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- done_reason</strong>: 生成停止原因</span></span></p>
<p><span>　　性能和模型使用情况的各项指标包括（<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">对于返回流式响应的接口，下面<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">字段会包含在结束标记为 true 的最后一个数据块中）<span>：</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>-&nbsp;</strong><span><strong>total_duration</strong><span>：生成响应的总时长（纳秒）</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>　　<strong>-&nbsp;</strong><span><span><strong>load_duration</strong><span>：模型加载所耗费的时长（纳秒）</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>　　<strong>-&nbsp;</strong><span><span><strong>prompt_eval_count</strong><span>：处理的输入 token 数量</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>　　<strong>-&nbsp;</strong><span><span><strong>prompt_eval_duration</strong><span>：评估提示词所耗费的时长（纳秒）</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>　　<strong>-&nbsp;</strong><span><span><strong>eval_count</strong><span>：处理的输出 token 数量</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>　　<strong>-&nbsp;</strong><span><span><strong>eval_duration</strong><span>：生成输出 token 所耗费的时长（纳秒）</span></span></span></span></span></p>
<h2><span><span>接口清单</span></span></h2>

<p><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span>　　注：<span>Ollama 兼容部分 OpenAI 和 Anthropic 的 API，具体内容请参考官网文档。</span></span></p>
<h1><span><span>安全问题</span></span></h1>
<h2><span><span>接口的安全<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{&quot;data-pm-slice&quot;:&quot;2 2 []&quot;},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]"><span>风险</span></span></span></span></h2>
<p><span><span>　　Ollama 只用于本地调用，不建议直接暴露到公网。<span>Ollama 开放的 11434 端口是其 API 服务入口，历史上曾因大量用户将端口直接暴露到公网，引发过多起严重安全事件。</span></span></span></p>
<p><span>　　API 无需身份校验和鉴权即可访问，谁能连上 11434 端口，谁就能控制你的 Ollama。</span></p>
<div><span><span><span><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202604/270073-20260413142429843-829114104.png" alt="12" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></span></span></span></div>
<h2>软件自身的安全漏洞</h2>
<p><span>　　Ollama 早期版本中存在多个高危漏洞，如果未及时升级，这些历史漏洞则仍然存在，易被攻击者利用。</span></p>
<h2 data-pm-slice="2 2 []"><span><span>Modelfile 的安全风险</span></span></h2>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- FROM&nbsp;</strong><span><span><strong>可指向外部恶意模型</strong>：<span>可能会指向恶意模型，<span>执行恶意代码。</span></span></span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- SYSTEM 提示注入</strong>：<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">SYSTEM&nbsp;<span>指令定义模型的核心行为规则，若 Modelfile 被篡改（或包含恶意提示词），模型会执行篡改后的恶意指令（如诱导泄露数据、执行高危操作）。</span></span></span></span></p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- PARAMETER 被篡改</strong>：<span>被篡改后会导致模型输出不可控（如生成违规内容、无意义文本），破坏业务逻辑。</span></span></span></p>
<h2><span><span>解决方案</span></span></h2>


<span><span><strong>　　- 核心原则</strong>：Ollama 优先仅限本地使用（绑定 127.0.0.1），非必要不暴露至公网；<span data-pm-slice="1 1 [&quot;para&quot;,{&quot;tagName&quot;:&quot;p&quot;,&quot;attributes&quot;:{},&quot;namespaceURI&quot;:&quot;http://www.w3.org/1999/xhtml&quot;}]">若需公网访问，需做好代理 + 认证也来有效规避风险。</span></span></span>
<p><span><span><strong>　　- 端口防护</strong>：11434 端口禁止做公网端口映射、不开放防火墙，建议改非知名自定义端口。</span></span></p>
<p><span><span><img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202604/270073-20260413142540578-1168420348.png" alt="14" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto"></span></span></p>
<p>　　<strong>- 版本安全</strong>：始终使用 Ollama 最新稳定版，及时修复已知漏洞。</p>
<p><span><span>　　<strong>- 模型管控</strong>：仅加载官方 / 可信来源的模型，拒绝来源不明的模型。</span></span></p>
<h1><span><span>小结</span></span></h1>
<p><span>　　Ollama 为我们打开了本地大模型的大门，让 AI 触手可及。希望这篇指南能帮助你快速上手，开启你的本地 AI 之旅。</span></p>
<p><span>&nbsp;</span></p>
<p><span><span>　　我希望您喜欢这篇文章，并一如既往地感谢您阅读并与朋友和同事分享我的文章。</span></span></p>
<div>&nbsp;<img src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/270073/202508/270073-20250825145337681-1658462272.png" alt="me" loading="lazy" style="display: block; margin-left: auto; margin-right: auto">
<p>&nbsp;</p>
